annotation.title_clean: ISO/CD TS 23793-2 Intelligent transport systems — Minimal risk manoeuvre (MRM) for automated driving — Part 2: Road shoulder stop — Minimum requirements and test procedures
annotation.title_en: ISO/CD TS 23793-2 Intelligent transport systems — Minimal risk manoeuvre (MRM) for automated driving — Part 2: Road shoulder stop — Minimum requirements and test procedures
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for draft Technical Specification ISO/CD TS 23793-2 (ISO/TC 204), covering minimum requirements and test procedures for an automated driving system's road shoulder stop minimal risk manoeuvre. It is at committee draft stage (30.60) and excludes failure detection and the decision to initiate the manoeuvre.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines minimum requirements and performance test procedures for the MRM-SS road shoulder stop by automated driving systems
Covers basic functions, control strategy and reactions on failure, from initiation to reaching a minimal risk condition
Excludes failure detection and the decision to initiate an MRM
Refers to ISO 26262 and ISO 21448 for robust system design, but these are outside its scope
Committee draft stage, with the comment period closed
